description: Source code implementing autograd functions and backward pass logic for PyTorch's C++ backend, including gradient creation, backward execution, and forward automatic differentiation level management.

classes.name: Identity
classes.description: Placeholder class used in autograd graph for tensors that do not require grad.

classes.name: ForwardADLevel
classes.description: Manages levels for forward automatic differentiation.

methods.name: _make_grads
methods.description: Creates gradient tensors for outputs, handling scalar and complex cases.

methods.name: run_backward
methods.description: Executes the backward pass given output tensors, gradients, and execution options.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Performs backward propagation on given tensors with optional gradient tensors.

methods.name: grad
methods.description: Computes gradients of outputs with respect to inputs, with options for graph retention and unused tensors.

methods.name: enter_dual_level
methods.description: Enters a new forward AD level, returning its index.

methods.name: exit_dual_level
methods.description: Exits a specified forward AD level.
